entries.reason: Creating a workspace writes the paid Premium seat count. 0355 is applied before this code is deployed: the release applies pending migrations first, and paid checkout stays behind the waitlist until then.
The member list returns each member's seat type. 0355 is applied before this code is deployed; without it the list query fails closed rather than returning members with a guessed seat.
The webhook stores the Premium seat count Stripe bills. 0355 is applied before this code is deployed; a subscription event that arrives first is retried by Stripe until the column exists.
Seat entitlement reads the member's seat type. 0355 is applied before this code is deployed; without it the seat lookup fails and the resolver falls back to no seat rather than granting one.

Assigning a seat type writes the membership seat columns. 0355 is applied before this code is deployed; without it the assignment fails and nothing is charged twice, because Stripe quantities are set to absolute values.
